title_home: Tamnex | The AI-native ERP for Saudi businesses
desc_home: Tamnex brings accounting, inventory, purchasing and e-invoicing into one system, and shows what blocks your month-end close before the month ends. Monthly and annual plans in SAR.
desc_pricing: Tamnex monthly and annual plans: Launch, Growth, Scale and Enterprise, with prices before and after VAT and a full comparison of features and limits.
og_title: Tamnex: the AI-native ERP for your accounting, inventory and invoicing
hero_sub: Forward-thinking finance teams rely on Tamnex to unify accounting and inventory, close their books faster, and track margins and cash in real time.
hero_points: Continuous, real-time close: every transaction reconciled and matched as it happens, giving you up-to-date financial statements on any day, not just at month end.
Proactive margin protection (Nexa): live detection of supply-cost and selling-price deviations, stopping margin erosion before transactions are approved.
Fully automated invoicing and operations: phase 1 compliant e-invoicing, and Fatoora integration for your company before its wave date.

The full year is paid in advance; its monthly equivalent is shown next to it.
The feature is part of the plan and becomes available to the plan's subscribers when it launches, with no change to the agreed price.
What happens if I choose a plan now?
We receive your request and contact you before launch to confirm price and features. No payment is taken before activation.
faq: Does AI post entries or close the period for me?
No. It reads, explains and prepares drafts. Approval, posting and closing stay with a user who has the permission, and every suggestion is logged.

Yes. Phase 1 (generation and storage): gapless numbering, the authority's QR format, no deleting an approved invoice, and cancellation by credit note. Phase 2 (integration): we connect your company to the Fatoora platform before its mandated wave date.
Does my company get its own address?
Yes. You choose your company's address when you subscribe, and each company has its own isolated users and data.
How do I move from my current system?
We import master data and balances and reconcile them with you before approval. Enterprise onboarding is run by our team.
Can I delete a wrong invoice or entry?
Not after approval. An invoice is cancelled by a linked credit note and an entry by a reversing entry, so every correction stays visible to your auditor.
